author: CodeX Studio
name: Platform backend module
description: A module of the platform: the module class library (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api), its thin host and its tests. Use scripts/new-module, which also adds it to platform.yaml, generates its migrations and creates the frontend module.

key.description: The module key from platform.yaml, for example goods-receipt.

camel.description: The key in camelCase, for message keys, for example goodsReceipt.

product.description: The product's PascalCase name from platform.yaml (the root namespace).
